payload.title: Close ClayCode WP03 typed IR then feed WP04 authority/effect checking on target VPS
payload.work_clay: Start from current main where CC-WP-01 and CC-WP-02 are PASS and CC-WP-03 is the first open BASE package. Implement the smallest production typed canonical IR that preserves records/enums/collections/results/epochs/resources/semantic identities and the current self.root AgencyState/web-ingress types. Separate semantic-content identity from authority identity: untrusted web evidence and authenticated direct messages may carry semantically equal content but must remain nominally non-coercible authority classes. Authority/session freshness is epoch-bound where applicable. Bearer host/resource/capability possession is opaque/non-serializable and cannot be reconstructed from descriptive JSON/text fields. Do not expand surface syntax unless an executable counterexample proves current frozen semantics insufficient. After WP03 target-VPS positive/negative fixtures pass, feed the exact typed identities into WP04 effect/action-trace checking with static summaries plus residual runtime checks for dynamic scope/freshness/resource facts.
payload.reason_clay: Current BASE critical path is 2/14 PASS with WP03 first open. Fresh 2026 primary research supports a hybrid typed capability/effect/trace boundary rather than payload-convention authority; a 200000-pair local Authority-Twin metamorphic proxy showed the intended discriminator blocks structural web->direct authority collapse while preserving content equivalence. The prior BASE14 job cannot be current because its own host-change invalidator fired and its goal_ref points to the superseded Andreas-PC target.
payload.completion_clay: WP03 may receive PASS only from production canonical-IR receipts with positive/negative typed corpus, semantic-vs-authority identity discrimination, stale-epoch rejection where applicable, opaque-handle non-forgeability at serialization boundaries, and real self.root AgencyState/WebEvidenceClay/authenticated-direct-message fixtures accepted without untyped escape hatch on the accepted Hostinger target VPS. Then WP04 must demonstrate precise type/effect diagnostics, requested-action visibility, forged/stale/revoked capability rejection, web instruction/effect authority NONE, valid safe direct-message execution posture, destructive/security-sensitive gating, and residual runtime checks for dynamic facts. No proxy result alone closes either package.
payload.executor_policy: Prefer the current ChatGPT/GitHub implementation lane for append-only source/receipt work and the verified Hostinger target-VPS runner for exact executable acceptance when transport permits. Re-read main/work revision before every effect. If the Clay repo runner remains ineligible, use only an authorized hash-bound bridge or provisioned eligible runner; never treat transport/setup failure as language failure. Claude research lane is temporarily unavailable/non-overlap until current external Harness work completes. No paid/final training.
